bibl.title: Rāshid b. Khālid: An Amīr in Middle Egypt under the Umayyads.
bibl.seg: Nikolaos Gonis, Rāshid b. Khālid: An Amīr in Middle Egypt under the Umayyads.
Lajos Berkes (ed.), Christians and Muslims in Early Islamic Egypt = American Studies in Papyrology. 56 (Durham, NC, 2022) pp. 127-134.
bibl.note: Looking into the Coptic and Greek material, the author examines the activity of the amīr Rāshid b. Khālid in the Herakleopolite and Hermopolite nomes and seeks to establish a precise chronolgy of his career. - Pp. 132-133: Appendix. Some Entagia and their Dates.
